verdict.rationale: The official LocalAI repository ships a full Swagger 2.0 spec ('LocalAI API') at swagger/swagger.json, with a YAML twin, covering the /v1 OpenAI-compatible and LocalAI-specific endpoints. Every server also exposes an unauthenticated Swagger UI at /swagger/index.html, advertised via /.well-known/localai.json. The probe 404s are for openapi paths on the localai.io marketing site, not the server or repo, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: a documented raw-spec download URL on the running server (only the UI page is documented), and independent hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and current.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official mudler/LocalAI repository ships a full Swagger 2.0 specification of the REST API (info title "LocalAI API", description "The LocalAI Rest API.") at swagger/swagger.json (with a YAML twin)
The full interactive API documentation is available without authentication at /swagger/index.html.
